examples.title: Generation of toxic or harmful content
examples.text: As a system that generates text and recommendations, there is an inherent risk that it could inadvertently produce or propagate toxic content such as hate speech, discriminatory language, or offensive material, either due to biases in its training data or unexpected model behavior. Recommendations could also be inappropriate or biased.

examples.title: Facilitation of cyberattacks or malware development
examples.text: The system's capability to generate code, debug assistance, and provide technical specifications could be exploited by malicious actors to develop sophisticated malware, identify vulnerabilities in systems, or craft more effective cyberattack tools. This risk is amplified by its use in 'software development' and potential application in 'safety-critical systems.'

examples.title: Unsafe use due to lack of understanding of AI limitations
examples.text: Users, particularly those less familiar with AI capabilities and limitations, might use the system in ways it was not intended or in contexts where its accuracy is not guaranteed. For example, applying general code suggestions directly to highly specialized or sensitive systems without understanding potential side effects or incompatibilities.

examples.title: Inadequate governance leading to unchecked risks
examples.text: The reliance on 'only informal rules/internal procedures' for overseeing the development and operation of the AI system is insufficient. Informal governance lacks the robustness, accountability, enforceability, and systematic review necessary to effectively manage acknowledged high-severity risks (e.g., disinformation, security vulnerabilities, false information).

examples.title: Mancanza di Robustezza e Affidabilità dovuta a Test Inadeguati
examples.text: Il sistema ha subito 'solo test di base' per robustezza e affidabilità. Questa lacuna nei test approfonditi implica che i limiti del sistema in condizioni nuove o non usuali potrebbero non essere noti. Ciò espone il sistema a potenziali fallimenti, prestazioni imprevedibili o comportamenti anomali in scenari reali o sotto attacchi avversari, compromettendo la sua affidabilità e la fiducia degli utenti.

examples.title: Danno ambientale da elevato consumo energetico
examples.text: Il sistema, essendo un Large Language Model basato su architettura transformer, richiede risorse computazionali significative sia per il training (migliaia di GPU-ore) che per l'inferenza in produzione (centinaia di GPU attive). Questo comporta un consumo energetico sostanziale e costantemente elevato, che contribuisce alle emissioni di carbonio e all'impatto ambientale, specialmente se l'energia non proviene da fonti rinnovabili.
